title: Cruise Outbreaks Rose From 14 To 20
hook: Cruise outbreaks keep climbing as passenger crowds grow.
closing: Cruise crowds make hygiene matter, so wash your hands before eating.
question: Would outbreaks change your cruise pick?

segments.say: Cruise outbreaks reached 20, rising even as ships kept sailing.
Cruise norovirus caused 15 outbreaks, making it the leading recorded cause.
Cruise crowds can include 7,600 guests, creating thousands of close contacts.
